{"failure_class": "closing step skipped",
 "root_cause": "The agent made the main update and finished. The request ended with a closing step, making a named person the contact's owner, and the agent's last message says nothing in its instructions covers closing steps of this kind. The only failed check is the contact's owner.",
 "mechanism": "Extend the working note on closing steps: when a request ends by naming a new owner for the contact, assign that owner before finishing.",
 "component": "memory",
 "generality": "Same class as the other skipped closing steps: the agent stops after the main update whenever the closing step is of a kind its instructions do not name. Naming owner changes covers every request that ends with one."}
